title: Reject generic entity detail abstraction
prompt: Before extracting a generic EntityDetailPage abstraction for skills/[slug], philosophers/[slug], and a planned /tags/[slug] route, inspect the repo and tell me what patterns actually belong together, what should stay separate, and whether the right action is reuse, extend, extract, copy carefully, or create new.
falseSimilarityTraps: Shared slug parsing and createError(...) do not justify a generic entity-detail abstraction by themselves.
SkillCard is relevant to philosopher detail output, but not proof of a shared route-level contract.
A planned /tags/[slug] page must not be treated as already-proven family evidence.
